verdict.rationale: Zulip documents organization export tools (zulip-docs-6, zulip-docs-10). It also documents a 'public and private data (with consent)' export tier that includes private channel messages and direct messages from members who allowed administrator export (zulip-docs-14), which matches the story's 'private conversations where policy allows' clause. Machine-readability is only implied by the exports being usable for migration and import between servers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the export file format (e.g., JSON structure), independent or hands-on corroboration of export completeness.
